text:
sophie: Hey team — customer reported API calls flipping regions mid-request and seeing >200ms extra RTT sometimes. Happens with our JS SDK v2.3.4 when requests time out and retry.

kai: Which retry mode are they using? hedged or sequential backoff?

sophie: They said default hedged=true in their config. Also using regionRouting: 'auto'.

raj: Ugh, hedged + auto-routing can cause one request to go to primary region then a hedged attempt to fallback region if primary seems slow. Could explain region hopping.

elaine: Do we have logs for a request id? customer provided request_id=rn_8a7c2b.

sophie: Pasted the logs from their tenant (redacted):
```
[1729345678.120] request rn_8a7c2b -> routed region: eu-west-1 -> attempting connection
[1729345678.330] rn_8a7c2b -> partial response received (60ms), connection stalled
[1729345678.550] rn_8a7c2b -> SDK hedged attempt -> routed region: us-west-2
[1729345770.012] rn_8a7c2b -> response from us-west-2 accepted (118ms)
[1729345770.023] rn_8a7c2b -> original eu-west-1 later completed (1200ms)
```

kai: That log is classic: hedged attempt fires because the SDK's per-request stall threshold is low, so it starts a hedged request to a different region. The SDK accepts the fastest reply and cancels the other, but network still hit both regions.

sophie: Customer complaint: increased observed latency variance and extra export billing (they're on committed capacity) — asking for fix/mitigation.

raj: Short-term: tell them to set hedged=false in SDK, or increase hedged delay threshold. Also can pin region to avoid auto-routing.

elaine: We should reproduce internally. Steps I suggest: 1) run a local proxy that delays responses from eu-west-1 by 800ms, 2) use their SDK config:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.KEY,
  regionRouting: 'auto',
  hedged: true,
  hedgedDelayMs: 200
})
```
Then watch the outbound connections.

infra-bot: [alert] RouteHealthMonitor: eu-west-1 spike in P50 latency observed at 1729345600.

support-bot: Ticket #54321 updated: customer provided repro script.

kai: For a longer-term fix: make hedged routing region-aware so hedged attempts prefer replicas in the same AZ/region group, or only hedge within same region before cross-region fallbacks. Also surface a metric: hedged_cross_region_count.

sophie: Agreed. I'll escalate to runtime team. For now I'll send the mitigation steps to the customer: set hedged:false OR set hedgedDelayMs to >500ms OR pin region. Also ask them to share any billing anomalies.

raj: Add a note to docs: "Hedged requests may create additional cross-region traffic under 'auto' routing — to avoid duplicate regional requests pin region or disable hedging."

elaine: I'll add an internal jira: INF-9873 "Hedged attempts crossing regions by default -> implement same-region hedging policy".

sophie: Thanks all — I'll update ticket #54321 with repro steps and workaround. If they want we can run a brief trace with them. :thumbsup:

kai: One more quick diagnostic for support to request: capture SDK debug logs with env REDWOOD_SDK_LOG=debug and include `outbound_region` field per request so we can correlate.

sophie: Done. Closing loop in ticket after customer confirms workaround.
